load_iris_dataset: load the iris dataset using sklearn.datasets.load_iris with as_frame=True
run_pca_decomposition: run PCA decomposition on iris data reducing to 3 principal components
plot_pairplot_features: plot a seaborn pairplot of iris features colored by target class
plot_3d_principal_components: plot a 3D scatter of first three PCA components colored by iris class
fit_transform_pca: fit and transform iris data with PCA to a reduced feature space
